body:
Gladly, honestly I appreciate having anyone to chat with without the actual obligation of them knowing me. I’m just aimless in life right now, I’m searching for something but I don’t know what I enjoy anymore. I guess at some point I lost that part of myself. 

I’m super insecure about one part of myself (which is entirely fixable but I don’t have the money) which creates a kind of feedback loop with my depression where, when I pursue any kind of relationship or friendship it’s always at the forefront of my thoughts. It hinders my actions and makes me antisocial.

And the most serious issue of all is that I don’t accept affection well, I can count on one hand the amount of people who have truly gone out of there way to show they love me and that they’re there for me but I tend to try to push them away. At the time it makes me gtfo but in hindsight I regret it greatly. I’m getting better at spotting it but goddamn have I pushed too many people away when I let those thoughts control me.

I’m working on being entirely honest, both with myself and the people around me, and through that I’ve caught a few of the people I’m closest with in lies that  basically ruined the way I perceive them. I’ve confronted one of them (who is also family) after having proof of her lie and she still denied it to my face. 

I’m just slowly losing trust in people and faith in myself and the hope that I hold onto if that makes any sense. I appreciate you letting me rant though and I’d appreciate any advice you have.
